name: Context Compiler (deterministic task -> versioned token-budgeted SAFE context packet)
purpose: The Collective Agent's context-compilation centerpiece (D-0080 directive Priority 4 / section 8; arch position 40), conformed to core-docs/CONTEXT_PACKET_CONTRACT.md (context_packet/0.2; s4 PINNED, D-0089) folding the frontier Wave-3 red-team blockers. 0.3 (i31 SELECTION-POLICY SETTLE) realizes P1-1 'one selection owner': it RETIRES the in-module selpol_reference.py stub and IMPORTS #37's ONE CANONICAL selpol_rrf_v1 (modules/37-retrieval-eval/lib/) by a resolved portable path -- the packet schema stays context_packet/0.2; only the selection SOURCE changes. A DETERMINISTIC, CPU-only, stdlib-only Python worker (context_compiler.py) behind a thin PowerShell entrypoint that turns a task descriptor into a versioned, token-budgeted, SAFE, self-describing lifeorch.context_packet/0.2 artifact the coordinator hands a disposable model. It: normalizes the task into a deterministic query set (8.1); retrieves a broad candidate set across record_kinds via a DEFINED retriever seam (8.2); selects/orders candidates by calling #37's canonical selpol_rrf_v1 through the frozen select(candidates, descriptor, policy_id, params) interface (P1-1 / D-0089 -- IMPORTED, not reimplemented; policy_version 1.0.0; raw-fused-score-primary composite + AUTHORITY_RANK/freshness ranks + greedy source-MMR + occurrence-preserving display dedup), supplying params.hard_filter from control_plane.permission_grants (+ descriptor forbidden/privacy), NEVER from an evidence field, with ADDITIVE selection fields that PRESERVE the retrieval order (retrieval/lexical/vector/fused_rank + selection_rank/score/policy_id/selected/reason_codes/rrf_score; the i29 self-contained composite score and the i30 reference stub are RETIRED); fills a configurable token budget with EXACT per-section + total accounting using a fixed HEURISTIC UPPER-BOUND token-count function (ceil(chars/4), NO tokenizer, NO model). The packet has THREE top-level regions with different trust origins (P0-1 SAFETY-CRITICAL): control_plane (policy/permission_grants/request_authority/side_effect_policy/completion_contract/escalation_conditions -- populated ONLY from the descriptor's coordinator/authority fields in a code path that CANNOT read retrieved records, so imperative text in a retrieved README/log can NEVER create a permission grant, set the side-effect policy, or define the completion contract), task_input (original_goal verbatim + normalized_task + constraints + requested_side_effects, which are REQUESTS not authorization), and evidence (every excerpt + ref carries content_role=evidence, can_instruct=false, trust_domain, epistemic_authority, and A2 provenance). It emits a top-level non_execution:true flag and a rendering contract (control_plane first, task_input, then evidence LAST inside hard delimiters as quoted data). It carries a mandatory packet_disposition (answerable|needs_expansion|abstain|conflicted|provenance_failed, P0-3) derived from evidence_requirements/coverage_results/missing_requirements/contradictions -- a normal answer is permitted ONLY when answerable, conservative while the vector channel is empty. It carries a mandatory consumer_profile (model/tokenizer/chat-template/max_context/reserved_* -- P0-4), counts on the FINAL RENDERED input with count_method=conservative_upper_bound + count_is_exact=false, and FAILS CLOSED on transport (oversize evidence drops to the omission_manifest, never truncating control_plane/completion_contract/a required citation). Each excerpt carries A2 provenance (record_content_hash/source_content_hash/excerpt_hash + a provenance_mode in direct_span|derived_record|aggregate|tombstone with per-mode validation; reading a direct_span reproduces the cited bytes -- P0-2). Packet identity/lineage (P1-5): distinct task_id/packet_id(cpkt_+content hash)/parent_packet_id/expansion_id; ONE corpus_version per compile (ABORT on drift); the 0.1 omitted_context is RENAMED omission_manifest. Skill activation cards are recognised as record_kind=summary + attrs.summary_type=skill_activation_card (A3) in addition to structural #38 skill records. A deterministic adaptive-expansion seam `expand` (8.5) returns an IMMUTABLE lifeorch.context_expansion/0.2 delta with the corpus snapshot LOCKED to the parent + a depth bound (NOT a live agent loop). Packet-evaluation hooks (8.6) record per-stage retrieval/post-filter/packet, packet_disposition correctness, and a P0-1 read-only injection probe, so retrieval.eval #37 0.2 can score coverage / provenance validity / packet tokens / disposition. CONSUMER of the FROZEN MEMORY_CONTRACT retriever-0.2 hit shape (s3) + s5 staleness enum + s1/A2 provenance envelope, and of #37's CANONICAL selpol_rrf_v1 (imported by a resolved portable path); PRODUCER of packets consumed by #37 eval + a fresh 9B at the orchestrator fold (D-0077). The RETRIEVER is INJECTED, never called from the deterministic worker: off-machine the entrypoint injects deterministic mock 0.2 hits from a fixture; -Live it runs the real artifact.search #36 `search` op. Non-goals (NOT built): ANY change to #37's selpol_rrf_v1 or its eval (imported READ-ONLY); pure-rank-RRF-as-PRIMARY (the deferred P1-2); real embeddings / vector search (the vector channel may be null); the retriever/catalog DB (#36); skill-CARD content (#41); the eval harness/metrics (#37); the 9B / ANY model; episode recording (#39); skill routing / plan validation; the FULL P0-1 adversarial injection SUITE + the action-capable gate release (a later wave); UI. Deterministic -> determinism=deterministic, confidence=null, empty model_provenance; the context_packet.json artifact is byte-identical on re-run (canonical JSON + a content-derived packet_id).

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -Op compile|normalize|expand (default compile); -Retriever mock|artifact_search (default mock); -CaseFile <path> (mock: a JSON case {task, retrieval_batches, source_texts, retrieval_meta, config?, consumer_profile?}); -Task <path|json> (the task descriptor for normalize / real-retriever compile); -DbPath <#36 catalog> + -RepoRoot <repo root> (-Live: the real retriever seam + span-text resolution); -K <int, default 20> (per-query candidate K); -Request <path|json> + -PacketFile <path> (expand); -ArtifactSearchEntry <path to #36 Invoke-ArtifactSearch.ps1> (default ..\36-artifact-search\Invoke-ArtifactSearch.ps1); -PythonPath <python>; -PwshPath <pwsh for launching #36>; -WorkerPath <context_compiler.py>. OR the generic -InputsJson '<json case>' (same shape as a CaseFile). Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: retriever
inputs.description: mock (deterministic fixture 0.2 hits, off-machine) | artifact_search (the real #36 search op, -Live).

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: the task descriptor {original_goal (IMMUTABLE, preserved verbatim), request_text, namespace/project_id?, task_type?, time_horizon?, authority?, requested_side_effects?, relevant_paths?, relevant_entities?, constraints?, open_questions?, completion_contract?, success_criteria?, escalation_conditions?, control_plane?{policy, permission_grants[], request_authority, side_effect_policy, completion_contract, escalation_conditions[]}, permission_grants?, side_effect_policy?, policy?, evidence_requirements?[{id,type:path|literal|record|any_evidence,value}], contradictions?, consumer_profile?{model_id,tokenizer_id,tokenizer_fingerprint,chat_template_id,max_context,reserved_system_tokens,reserved_tool_tokens,reserved_generation_tokens}, config?}. control_plane is built ONLY from these descriptor fields, NEVER from retrieval (P0-1).

inputs.name: retrieval_batches
inputs.description: mock: per-query batches [{query_index, query, hits:[<retriever-0.2 hit>...]}]. The injected candidate pool.

inputs.name: candidates
inputs.description: mock: a flat list of retriever-0.2 hits (treated as query_index 0) -- alternative to retrieval_batches.

inputs.name: source_texts
inputs.description: mock: {source_path: full_text} used to resolve + reproduce excerpt spans off-machine.

inputs.name: repo_root
inputs.description: -Live: resolve repo-relative source_path -> disk to read + reproduce the cited byte span.

inputs.name: retrieval_meta
inputs.description: provenance carried into the packet {retriever, retriever_version, corpus_version, index_snapshot, embedding_space_id, fusion_algo, fusion_version}. One corpus_version is pinned per compile; a drift across hits ABORTS (P1-5).

inputs.name: consumer_profile
inputs.description: P0-4 override of the default 9B consumer profile {model_id, tokenizer_id, tokenizer_fingerprint, chat_template_id, max_context, reserved_system_tokens, reserved_tool_tokens, reserved_generation_tokens}. The token count is computed on the FINAL RENDERED input against this profile; a real tokenizer is a later wave (count_is_exact=false today).

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: overrides {token_budget, per_source_cap, max_excerpts, per_excerpt_overhead_tokens, primary_terms_cap, salient_terms_cap, literals_cap, paths_cap, max_queries, candidate_k, expand_max_tokens, expand_max_depth, ref_cap}.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: expand: {type: raw_source|more_evidence|related_symbol|failure_record|tool_contract|prior_episode, target:{record_version_id|record_id|source_path+span}, budget:{max_tokens}, depth?, depth_bound?, namespace?, sensitivity_ceiling?}.

inputs.name: packet
inputs.description: expand: the compiled context packet (or -PacketFile) providing excerpt provenance + the parent corpus snapshot (the expansion delta is LOCKED to it).

inputs.name: expansion_candidates
inputs.description: expand: an injected pool of retriever-0.2 hits to expand from (real #36 or fixture); a candidate from a different corpus_version is refused (P1-5).

outputs.description: envelope.result = { op, retriever, result:<op payload>, worker, runtime_ms }. compile -> { packet:<lifeorch.context_packet/0.2>, packet_id, packet_content_hash, packet_disposition, metrics{candidate_count, excerpt_count, omitted_count, packet_tokens, rendered_tokens, budget, distinct_source_count, distinct_kind_count, provenance_reproduced_all, provenance_valid_all, requirements_total/satisfied/missing, contradiction_count, packet_disposition, dropped_*}, query_set[], config, consumer_profile } + byte-identical context_packet.json + rendered_input.txt artifacts. The packet carries: packet_id (cpkt_+sha256(body)[:32]); schema; non_execution:true; compiler; identity{task_id, task_descriptor_digest, parent_packet_id, expansion_id, corpus_version, compiler_version, selection_policy{id,version}, consumer_profile{tokenizer_id,fingerprint,model_id}, control_plane_grant_snapshot_ref, selected_record_version_ids[], budget, omission_manifest_digest}; control_plane{provenance, policy, permission_grants[], request_authority, side_effect_policy, completion_contract, escalation_conditions[], grant_snapshot_ref}; task_input{original_goal, normalized_task, task_type, time_horizon, namespace, constraints[], requested_side_effects[], open_questions[]}; evidence{excerpts[{excerpt_id, content_role, can_instruct, trust_domain, epistemic_authority, record_id, record_version_id, record_kind, source_path, source_version_id, span{start,end}, span_label, section_path, heading, chunk_type, namespace, currentness, text, token_estimate, provenance{provenance_mode, text_source, reproduced, valid, checked_against, span_sha256, source_content_hash, excerpt_hash, record_content_hash, ...}, selection{selection_rank, selection_score, selection_policy_id, reason_codes[], evidence_cluster_id, rrf_score, retrieval_occurrences[], retrieval_rank, lexical_rank, vector_rank, fused_rank, matched_queries}}], current_state_refs[], candidate_skills[] (record_kind=skill OR summary+summary_type=skill_activation_card), relevant_procedures[], relevant_failures[], similar_episodes[], evidence_contract}; disposition{packet_disposition, answerable, evidence_requirements[], coverage_results[], missing_requirements[], contradictions[], provenance_failed}; consumer_profile{...}; transport_accounting{count_method, count_is_exact, counted_on, max_context, reserved_*, transport_budget_tokens, rendered_tokens, rendered_input_sha256, fits, transport_overflow, control_plane_overflow, dropped_for_transport}; token_budget{token_fn, budget, used, remaining, ...}; selection{policy_id=selpol_rrf_v1, policy_version=1.0.0, owner=modules/37-retrieval-eval/lib/selpol_rrf_v1.py, descriptor, params(hard_filter from control_plane), features_by_candidate, stages[hard_filter,temporal,authority,rank_fusion_rrf,diversity,budget]}; omission_manifest[{record_version_id, record_kind, source_path, currentness, selection_rank, reason (deleted|duplicate_content|source_diversity_cap|max_excerpts|token_budget|transport_overflow|hard_filter), expand_hint?}]; retrieval_provenance{retriever, corpus_version, index_snapshot, embedding_space_id, vector_channel_status, fusion_algo, query_set[], per_query_hit_counts, candidate_count}; evaluation_hooks{retrieved[], packet_metrics, stages{raw_retrieval, post_filter, packet}, disposition_eval, injection_probe}; rendering; expansion_affordances. normalize -> { normalized_task, original_goal, task_type, time_horizon, namespace, salient_terms[], literals[], query_set[], exclude_stale, config }. expand -> { expansion:<lifeorch.context_expansion/0.2>{ expansion_id, parent_packet_id, immutable, corpus_snapshot{corpus_version, locked_to_parent}, namespace, sensitivity_ceiling, depth, depth_bound, request, evidence[{...provenance, can_instruct:false}], evidence_count, token_estimate, budget_tokens, bounded, truncated, non_execution } } + a context_expansion.json artifact.
